app.title: GitHub Dev Evaluator
app.subtitle: Evaluate any developer based on their public GitHub activity.
app.subtitle2: Get a score from 0 to 100 with fun titles and badges.
app.disclaimer: Only public GitHub data is analyzed. No data is stored.
error.title: Error
loading.detail: Fetching profile, repositories, commits, PRs, issues...

results.disclaimer: Scores are based on public GitHub data only. Private repos, enterprise work, and other contributions are not reflected. This is for fun, not hiring decisions.

archetype.reviewer.desc: Sharp eye for code quality. Reviews more than they ship — the team's quality gatekeeper.
archetype.contributor.desc: Thrives in the open source world. Sends PRs and files issues across projects they don't own.
archetype.builder.desc: Commits machine. Focused on building and shipping code in their own projects.
archetype.mergeMaster.desc: Reviews, approves, and merges. The trusted gatekeeper who decides what ships to production.
archetype.bugHunter.desc: Finds and reports bugs everywhere. A natural QA engineer with a sharp eye for broken things.
archetype.polyglot.desc: Speaks many programming languages. Comfortable jumping between different stacks and paradigms.
